# Forge Platform

> Bootstrap like a much larger engineering organization.

Forge Platform is an enterprise-grade platform engineering foundation for startups and greenfield engineering teams building distributed systems and microservice architectures.

Forge provides opinionated infrastructure, service patterns, operational tooling, observability, deployment workflows, and zero-trust security foundations so teams can ship production-grade systems without rebuilding internal platform infrastructure from scratch.

## Core resources

- [Home](https://forgeplatform.software/): Product overview, capabilities, architecture, and pricing
- [Blog](https://forgeplatform.software/blog/): Engineering insights on platform engineering, production readiness, and the foundations behind scalable software
- [FAQ](https://forgeplatform.software/faq/): Common questions about platform fit, onboarding, and commercial model

## Technical documentation

- [Forge technical docs](https://docs.forgeplatform.software): Architecture documentation, platform operations, infrastructure automation, deployment workflows, observability, service development patterns, and production engineering guidance
